verdict.rationale: Whether source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS accounting suite, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Zoho Books' source is available or openly licensed. The published OpenAPI document and REST API docs describe the interface, not the source code, and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
